units.source_text: 匂亲王遣使送信与二女公子，信中有言：“常思入山相会，每苦困难重重。

en.t: Prince Niou sent a messenger with a letter to the Second Young Lady, saying in it, “I am always thinking of going into the mountains to meet you, but each time I am troubled by one difficulty after another.

units.source_text: 拟请迁来京都，卜居敝邸附近。一切手续，均已办妥。”

en.t: I would like to ask you to move to the capital and take up residence near my humble mansion. All the necessary arrangements have already been made.”

units.source_text: 这是因为：明石皇后闻知匂皇子与二女公子之事，推想薰中纳言对大女公子如此痛苦地悼念，

en.t: This was because Empress Akashi had heard about Prince Niou and the Second Young Lady, and, thinking how bitterly Middle Counselor Kaoru had mourned the Elder Young Lady,

units.source_text: 可知其妹定非凡俗之女，因而匂皇子倾心爱慕。

en.t: she concluded that the younger sister too must be no ordinary woman, and that was why Prince Niou had fallen so deeply in love with her.

units.source_text: 她可怜匂皇子，便悄悄对他说道：“你可教二女公子迁居二条院来，以便时时相会。”

en.t: Taking pity on Prince Niou, she quietly said to him, “You may have the Second Young Lady move to Nijo-in, so that you can meet her from time to time.”

units.source_text: 匂亲王疑心母后以此为借口，欲命二女公子替大公主当侍女。

en.t: Prince Niou suspected that his mother was using this as a pretext, intending to make the Second Young Lady serve the First Princess in place of the elder sister.

units.source_text: 但念今后时时得与二女公子相见，实甚可喜。

en.t: Yet when he thought that from now on he would be able to see the Second Young Lady often, he found it truly delightful.

units.source_text: 因此写这信与二女公子。

en.t: For that reason he wrote this letter to the Second Young Lady.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言闻知此事，想道：“我营造三条宫邸，本想给大女公子居住。

en.t: When Middle Counselor Kaoru heard of this, he thought, “I built the Sanjo mansion intending it originally as a residence for the Elder Young Lady.

units.source_text: 大女公子既死，我正想迎二女公子来居，当作她的替身呢。”

en.t: Now that the Elder Young Lady has died, I was just thinking of bringing the Second Young Lady there to live, as a kind of substitute for her.”
As he looked back on the past, he was overcome with sorrow and longing.

units.source_text: 至于匂亲王所怀疑于他的，他认为全然不近情理，绝不起这念头。

en.t: As for the suspicion Prince Niou had formed about him, Kaoru considered it completely unreasonable and never entertained such a thought at all.

units.source_text: 他只是想：“能代父母照顾她的，除了我以外更有何人呢？”

en.t: He only thought, “Who besides me could take the place of her parents and care for her?”
